# William Frankel Plumbing

William Frankel Plumbing is a family drain and plumbing shop in Van Nuys, California.
We have worked from 16137 Valerio St since 1959.
We clear drains first and replace sewers only when the pipe is finished.
Our services are drain cleaning, trenchless sewer replacement, hydro jetting, sewer camera inspection, water heaters and plumbing repairs, and gas lines with earthquake valves.
We serve Van Nuys, the San Fernando Valley, Simi Valley, Calabasas, Agoura, Santa Monica, Pacific Palisades, Brentwood, Beverly Hills, and West LA.
We are California licensed C-36, licence number 270127.
Our shop hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM.
Call us at (818) 349-6100 or write to frankelplumbing@aol.com.
Our website is https://frankelplumbing.com/
